_comment: The Rogue's retail-style talent trees (format: localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json): a class tree and the
three WotLK specializations, in the order of their talent tabs (Assassinat, Combat, Finesse), which is the
order the bots take them in. The Combat tab is Hors-la-loi, retail's Outlaw (.agents/plans/outlaw-rogue): its
kit (specSpells) and its four active nodes are authored in localTools/rogue/Spells.ps1, its passive nodes are
rank spells read by modules/mod-rogue. Other nodes marked existing reuse WotLK talents or name an ability
authored in localTools/rogue/Spells.ps1; the others are generated by localTools/talentTree/TalentRankSpells.ps1
and read by modules/mod-rogue. Every spec learns 92191, which gives Sinister Strike back its 45 Energy cost (the
data makes it free). botBuild is the order a bot takes its nodes in.
